name: Meshelemiah
overview: Meshelemiah is identified in Scripture as a key gatekeeper of the temple, serving in a vital role among the Korhites, descendants of Asaph. His family, including his sons and brethren, were noted for their strength and responsibility in guarding the sacred entrances to the tabernacle and temple, exemplified by his son Zechariah's role as porter. This highlights the importance of faithful stewardship and service in maintaining the holiness and security of God's dwelling place.
